svg.title: Analog front end schematic, redrawn
svg.text: Redrawn for reading. Values are the as-built bench board (R8 linked, gain 1). U9 and U10 are MCP6004; pin numbers in brackets.
set by the DAC, not by the load
VOLTAGE SENSE (no current flows here, so mux resistance drops out)
Z = (V_sense / gain) ÷ (V_TIA / 200 k) = 200 000 × V_sense / V_TIA at gain 1. Self-calibration then maps raw Z onto R20 and R22.
